create.title: New form
create.name: What will you call the form?
create.nameHint: Only you see the name. It is never shown to website visitors.
create.list: Which list will it write into?
create.listNone: None for now, just create the contact
create.listHint: Without a list the form only creates the contact and subscribes them nowhere.
create.failed: The form could not be created.

editor.activeHint: A paused form behaves as if it did not exist. The submission history stays.
editor.successMessageHint: What the person sees right after submitting the form. Leave it empty to use our default thank you.
editor.redirectUrlHint: The full address including https://. If you fill it in, the person lands on your page instead of ours. Empty keeps them with us.
editor.consent: Consent text next to the checkbox
editor.consentHint: It is stored with every signup as proof of what the person agreed to. An empty field means no consent is recorded.
editor.fieldsHint: This is what the form collects. The set of fields is changed through the API for now.
editor.signups: {count, plural, =0 {No signups yet} one {# signup in total} other {# signups in total}}
editor.failed: The change could not be saved.
editor.deleteConsequenceForm: The form stops existing and its public address stops working. Anyone who embedded it sees nothing.
editor.deleteConsequenceSubmissions: The submission history is deleted too. Contacts that came through the form stay.
editor.deleteConsequenceAlternative: If you only want to stop the form for a while, turn off the switch The form collects signups.

embed.delegateNote: We do not send the email for you yet. Copy the instructions with the code and send them from your own mailbox.
embed.delegateCopy: Copy the instructions with the code
embed.instructionsIntro: Hello, please put a subscription form on our website. Just paste this code into the page where the form belongs:
embed.instructionsOutro: The code measures nothing and tracks no visitors. If a script cannot be used on the website, let us know, we also have a frame version and a plain HTML form.
embed.stylingTitle: Your website decides how it looks
embed.stylingBody: The embedded form carries no CSS. These are the hooks you can target and the states the form reports:
embed.stylingStates: The form state is in the data-ml-state attribute (idle, sending, done, error). A field with an error has data-ml-invalid="true".
embed.stylingHosted: The ready-made page on our address is the exception: it is ours, so it does have styles.
embed.variantIframeNoJs: The frame works even on a website with JavaScript turned off, because our page runs inside it. The website cannot style the form inside the frame though, the script option is for that.

email.title: The email the person receives
email.hintDoubleOptIn: It goes out only when the person clicks the confirmation link. Until then they get nothing.
email.hintDirect: It goes out right after the form is submitted, because email confirmation is off.
email.create: Create an email for this form
email.createFailed: The email could not be created.
email.ebookHint: Write anything into the email, typically a link to download the promised file.
email.sendingWarning: This project has not sent a campaign yet, and that is where the sending account comes from. Until then the form email will not go out.
email.confirmVsWelcome: This is the welcome email, the one with the download link. The confirmation email that only verifies the address is composed by us and cannot be edited: if its confirmation link could be overwritten, subscribing would silently stop working.
email.sharedWithList: The email belongs to this form, not to the list. Another form writing into the same list can therefore send a different file.

fields.title: What the form collects
fields.lead: Add the fields you need. The form writes straight into the contact.
fields.emailLocked: Email cannot be removed. Without an address there is nobody to subscribe or reply to.
fields.limit: A form can have at most {max} fields. {left} left.
fields.limitReached: The form cannot hold more fields. Remove some, or make do with these.
fields.newFieldKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. The API and imports look the field up by it.
fields.newFieldSubmit: Create and add to the form
fields.newFieldFailed: The custom field could not be created.
fields.multiEnumUnsupported: Fields with several selected values cannot be collected by a form yet.
fields.alreadyUsed: The form already collects this field.
fields.optionsFromField: Values are taken from the custom field so the two cannot drift apart.
fields.previewHint: This is the form without a single style rule. Looks come from the website you embed it into.
fields.saveFailed: The fields could not be saved.
fields.dragHandle: Move field {label}. Use arrow up and down to reorder.
